queries.item: CREATE TABLE `?:rf_stock_parser` ( `my_supplier_id` mediumint(8) UNSIGNED NOT NULL auto_increment, `type` varchar(5) DEFAULT 'xls', `supplier_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `manufacturer_field` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manufacturer_code', `extra_charge` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `extra_charge_type` tinyint(1) not null default 0, `cron` text NULL, `timestamp` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `amount_synonyms` TEXT NULL, `price_synonyms` TEXT NULL, `features_synonyms` TEXT NULL, `avail_strategy_in` TINYINT(1) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `avail_strategy_not_in` TINYINT(1) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `column_settings` MEDIUMTEXT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL default 'A', `access_time` int NOT NULL default 0, `pricing_strategy` TINYINT(1) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `custom_node_name` varchar(255) NULL, `keep_logs_days` SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, `filter_attributes` varchar(255) NULL, `amount_field` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'amount', `amount_field_not_in_schema` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'amount', `amount_field_not_in_schema_value` int(11) DEFAULT 100, `extra_charge_custom` longtext NULL, `new_pos` TEXT NULL, `autoimport` tinyint(1) not null default 0, `attach_to_master` tinyint(1) not null default 0, `xml_fix_wrong_encode` tinyint(1) not null default 0, `price_round` text NULL, `constructor_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `wh_clear` TEXT NULL, `link_to_products` tinyint(1) unsigned not null, `update_price_is_out_of_stock` enum ('update', 'set_zero', 'keep') default 'update' not null, PRIMARY KEY (`my_supplier_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8

CREATE TABLE `?:rf_stock_parser_logs` ( `id` int UNSIGNED NOT NULL auto_increment, `my_supplier_id` mediumint(8) UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `user_id` mediumint(8) UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `general` TEXT NULL, `duplicates` MEDIUMTEXT NULL, `categories` MEDIUMTEXT NULL default NULL null, `detailed` TINYINT(1) UNSIGNED not null default 0, `large_percentage` TINYINT(1) UNSIGNED not null default 0, `attach_id` int UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `date` DATETIME NULL, `access_time` int NOT NULL default 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8

CREATE TABLE `?:rf_stock_parser_logs_not_found` ( `id` int UNSIGNED NOT NULL auto_increment, `my_supplier_id` mediumint(8) UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `value` MEDIUMTEXT NULL, `added` TINYINT(1) UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `manufacturer_code` varchar(255) not null, `brand` varchar(255) null, `category_id` int null, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), INDEX (my_supplier_id), INDEX (added), INDEX (manufacturer_code), INDEX (brand), INDEX (category_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8

CREATE TABLE `?:rf_stock_parser_logs_detailed` ( `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL auto_increment, `my_supplier_id` mediumint(8) UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `access_time` int NOT NULL default 0, `product_id` mediumint(8) UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `type` TINYINT(2) UNSIGNED NOT NULL default 0, `value` MEDIUMTEXT NULL, `p_price` mediumint(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `large_percentage` TINYINT(1) UNSIGNED NOT NULL default 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), INDEX (my_supplier_id, access_time), INDEX (product_id), INDEX (large_percentage) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8

CREATE TABLE `?:rf_stock_parser_brands` ( `id` int UNSIGNED NOT NULL auto_increment, `my_supplier_id` mediumint(8) UNSIGNED NOT NULL, `brand_id` mediumint(8) UNSIGNED NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), INDEX (my_supplier_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8

CREATE TABLE `?:rf_stock_parser_xml_nodes` ( `constructor_id` int(11) unsigned not null, `name` varchar(255) not null, `attrs` text not null, INDEX (constructor_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8
ALTER TABLE `?:products` ADD COLUMN `supplier_amount` mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE `?:products` ADD COLUMN `manufacturer_code` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '';
ALTER TABLE `?:products` ADD COLUMN `rf_stop_update_price` varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N'
ALTER TABLE `?:products` ADD COLUMN `rf_stop_update_amount` varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N'
ALTER TABLE `?:products` ADD COLUMN `rf_stop_update_status` varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N'

create table ?:rf_stock_parser_process ( parser_id int not null, type tinyint default 1 not null, percent tinyint default 0 not null, error_message text null, running tinyint default 0 not null, last_change int null, process_message varchar(255) null, data text null, PRIMARY KEY (`parser_id`, `type`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8;

create table ?:rf_stock_parser_artefacts ( id int auto_increment, parser_id int not null, name varchar(255) not null, value text null, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), unique (parser_id, name) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=UTF8;
